nom: COSRX The Retinol 0.5 Oil with Super Vitamin E + Squalane

segments.oily: Oily and acne-prone reviewers report the oil does not increase shine and one describes no purging while seeing improved texture, though one reviewer with oily skin found it stayed visibly oily on the skin for a while after application.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report it does not dry them out further and even helps with existing dryness or flaking, sometimes replacing a more drying prescription retinoid.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with eczema, rosacea, or perioral dermatitis, mostly describe it as gentle and non-irritating, though one with perioral dermatitis says it triggered a flare.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or being in their 30s-40s report visible softening of fine lines, improved firmness, and it becoming a permanent part of their routine.
segments.combination: One reviewer with hormonal, cycle-related acne on otherwise combination skin reports good hydration and smoother complexion without noting increased oiliness.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for fine lines, wrinkles, or firmness report visible softening within weeks to a few months, including around the eyes and neck; a couple of reviewers with more advanced anti-aging routines (retin-A, multi-acid) say it did not do much for them.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers describe it as hydrating rather than drying, with skin feeling plump and moisturized the next morning, and several note it did not cause the dryness/flaking typical of other retinols.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or reactive skin report no irritation or redness; no dissent is reported on this specific point.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers say it did not compromise their skin barrier or cause stinging over time, though a few mention a brief stinging or peeling adjustment period before tolerance built up.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark marks, acne scarring, and discoloration, including one describing a large dark spot reduced by about 70% after one use; results are generally described as gradual over weeks to months.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts or clearer skin over time with no purging, but others experienced minor breakouts when overusing it too frequently, and one reviewer's acne surfaced when substituting it into an active-heavy routine.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including one who is oily-prone, say it does not add oiliness, but two reviewers explicitly describe the product itself feeling oily and slow to absorb after application.

aspects.libelle: Gradual purging or peeling adjustment period

extraits.titre: Sensitive skin approved. Not functional bottle shape
extraits.texte: The product is fantastic. My sensitive skin and eczema was happy with the dose. Unfortunately the shape of the bottle and the length of the dropper is not great. It made it very difficult to get product out and had to tilt the bottle for a 4th of the time using it.

I really am skeptical with any new skin care routine since I have rosacea and my skin is extremely sensitive. I was surprised on how non-greasy this was and that my skin had zero irritation. I could see results after three weeks on the fine lines between my eyebrows and at my temple. I keep this in a mini makeup fridge so the product stays chilled. I think it helps. I've continued to use this with no bad reactions. I received this product free through COSRX and influenster in exchange for a review of my honest opinion.

extraits.titre: I'm glowing! And my skin is looking better!!
extraits.texte: Needed to increase the retinol % since my last bottle didn't do much for me so i got this. I noticed results after 3 months, using it 2 times a week at night. Zero purging! I've been glowing way more than usual and my skin texture has improved so much! Fyi, i have oily, acne-prone, and dehydrated skin. I highly recommend this if ur an experienced retinol user Also i think that putting it in the fridge also gave me better results!

I turned 30 and this is saving my skin!! My skin has been drying out from using other acne treatments, and this is the only thing that helps with acne and dry skin! even though it's an oil, it doesn't clog my pores!

This Retinol oil is so lightweight and it doesn't clog my pores at all. I have extremely dry, textured, and dehydrated skin and this is the perfect last step to my routine. Perfect for sealing in the moisture without a greasy look or feel. Usually I avoid oils and tend to go for a pretty thick layer of Vaseline at night to slug with and this actually pairs really well with a lighter layer of that, but also feels great on its own. Really absorbs into the skin and makes it look glowy and hasn't left my skin dry, itchy, or flakey even combined with a retinol cream. Somehow only a drop or 2 covers my entire face and neck. Pure magic, highly recommend.

extraits.titre: It's fine, a bit oily feeling
extraits.texte: I've only been using this retinol serum for a week, so I can't speak to how well it works, but I will say its far more oily feeling than other retinols I've used. After application, my skin looks and feels oily for quite some time.

extraits.titre: Good but can be harsh if you have skin issues
extraits.texte: I have perioral dermatitis, so I wanted to love this. But it did trigger my PD. I'm gonna give it another shot ans hope it doesn't do that again. However I loved the feeling of it upon application and it didn't stink.
